title: Sync-client
summary: An Electron-based desktop client project whose README documents packaging the app into a Windows .exe installer. A separate helper script, synthetic_data_generator.py, uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with a SingleTableMetadata object to fit a model on a dataframe and generate synthetic tabular rows.
needs: Purpose of synthetic data generation within the Electron sync client is unclear from README; script appears auxiliary and unmentioned in project docs.
